content: {"episode_id":"ep-05186","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Medical necessity reconsideration is requested for CPT 93247 based on recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known unspecified atrial fibrillation and cardiac arrhythmia. The clinical indication note documents a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction and states that long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to assess for paroxysmal arrhythmic events and optimize anticoagulation management. The supplied clinical indication note does not document that less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed insufficient."}
